Designed from scratch: electric Rigitrac SKE 40 tractor

 11-09 | Field robots | News

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

The Rigitrac SKE 40 Electric has been designed from the ground up as an electric tractor. The tractor will also be on show at the ATH mechanisation trade fair, from 16 to 19 September in Biddinghuizen, Flevoland. Photo: Rigitrac

Importer Hissink is introducing the electric Rigitrac SKE 40 Electric, announced in 2020, to the Dutch market. The Swiss tractor has been designed as an electric machine from the ground up. With this, the manufacturer aims to reduce energy losses in the driveline and achieve a longer operating time per battery charge.

Unlike many electric tractors, the Rigitrac SKE 40 is not a converted diesel tractor. According to importer Hissink in Oeken, Gelderland, the selected electric drives reduce energy loss. The importer states that this allows the tractor to work for 4 to 6 hours, also with a mower or other implement.

Difference in driveline

According to Hissink, the difference lies mainly in the driveline. In tractors that have been converted from a diesel model to electric, transmission parts and hydraulic components remain present.

Rigitrac started with a completely new design for the SKE 40. The manufacturer did choose mechanical axles. An electric motor transfers the drive to the front and rear axle via a distribution mechanism. The tractor has 2 driving ranges: 1 up to 25 and 1 up to 40 kilometres per hour.

Separate motor for hydraulics

The hydraulics also have their own electric motor. The pump only runs when hydraulic power is needed. According to Hissink, limiting such losses helps achieve the stated operating time of 4 to 6 hours. The PTOs are also driven separately by electric motors.

Starting price without attachments

The SKE 40 Electric is now in series production. Hissink reports that 1 unit is currently operating in the Netherlands. The tractor can be ordered without attachments at a starting price of €190,000. Interested parties can request a demonstration from Hissink.

translationZh:
进口商Hissink正在将2020年发布的电动Rigitrac SKE 40 Electric引入荷兰市场。这款瑞士拖拉机从零开始设计为电动机械。制造商的目标是减少传动系统中的能量损失，并实现每次充电更长的作业时间。

与许多电动拖拉机不同，Rigitrac SKE 40并非由柴油拖拉机改装而来。据位于海尔德兰省奥肯的进口商Hissink称，所选用的电驱动系统减少了能量损失。该进口商表示，这使得拖拉机可以作业4至6小时，即使配备割草机或其他农具也是如此。

**传动系统的差异**

据Hissink称，差异主要体现在传动系统上。在由柴油型号改装为电动的拖拉机中，变速箱部件和液压组件仍然存在。

Rigitrac为SKE 40开始了全新的设计。制造商确实选择了机械车桥。一台电动机通过分配机构将动力传递至前桥和后桥。该拖拉机有2个行驶档位：1档最高25公里/小时，1档最高40公里/小时。

**液压系统独立电机**

液压系统也有自己的独立电动机。泵仅在需要液压动力时运行。据Hissink称，限制此类损耗有助于实现所宣称的4至6小时作业时间。动力输出轴（PTO）也由电动机独立驱动。

**不含农具的起售价**

SKE 40 Electric现已进入批量生产。Hissink报告称，目前有1台在荷兰运行。该拖拉机可不含农具订购，起售价为19万欧元。有意者可向Hissink申请演示。
